Class SignRequestClaimsVerifier<C extends SecurityContext>

java.lang.Object
com.nimbusds.jwt.proc.DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier<C>
se.oidc.nimbus.signrequest.SignRequestClaimsVerifier<C>
Type Parameters:
C - the security context type
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClockSkewAware, JWTClaimsSetVerifier<C>
public class SignRequestClaimsVerifier<C extends SecurityContext> extends DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier<C>
Claims verifier for a signed JWT holding a Signature Request Parameter that is passed as a custom request parameter, according to sections 3.1.2 and 5.1 of Signature Extension for OpenID Connect, version 1.2. The verifier asserts that:
  • the iss claim is present and equals the client ID of the requesting client,
  • the aud claim is present and holds one of the accepted audience values, i.e., the Issuer Identifier of the OpenID Provider or the Authorization Endpoint URL on which the request was received,
  • the JWT has not expired, if the exp claim is present,
  • the JWT was not issued too far in the past, if the iat claim is present and a maximum age has been set using setMaxAge(Duration).

The verifier can be installed in a Nimbus JWTProcessor that also verifies the JWT signature.

Author:
Martin Lindström

  • Method Details

    • setMaxAge

      public void setMaxAge(Duration maxAge)
      Sets the maximum allowed age of the JWT. If set, and the JWT contains the iat claim, a JWT that was issued longer ago than this (plus the allowed clock skew) is rejected. The default is null, meaning no check.
      Parameters:
      maxAge - the maximum age, or null for no check
